findings.summary: review_telemetry emit is the only Bash call in this file without the wt_on `cd <WT> &&` prefix, so the round record the producers wrote is read from the wrong root
findings.suggestion: Anchor round_record on the base root via resolve_base_root (as stage_agent_ledger does) rather than adding a cd prefix: cd <WT> would move the telemetry ROW into the worktree, which task-land deletes.
findings.evidence: finalize 516/518, measure 846/848, pin 806/808 carry the prefix; emit 1129/1133 do not. _take_measured_from_producers reads root=Path.cwd().

reasoning.observe: 11+ sibling Bash calls carry the prefix; emit is the sole exception
reasoning.trace: producers write <WT>/.claude/observability/.hm-round/; emit resolves from base cwd
reasoning.infer: read() returns {} and every measured field lands null with only a stderr warning
reasoning.conclude: reproduces the 0/69 defect this change exists to close, in the Production default

findings.summary: Producer/consumer cwd contract is unenforced; emit silently reads {} whenever the shell cwd is not <WT>
findings.suggestion: Resolve the base root explicitly in round_record so the store is cwd-independent.
findings.evidence: review_telemetry.py:420 root=Path.cwd(); review_consensus.py:684 Path('.'); review_churn.py:602 opts.root

reasoning.observe: every other producer command reasserts cd <WT> &&
reasoning.trace: cwd persistence across tool calls is an environment property, not a designed guarantee
reasoning.infer: breaks at a session boundary, after compaction, or after a subagent dispatch
reasoning.conclude: either a live defect or an inconsistency with zero cost to close

findings.summary: Ordering hazard: worktree-scoped producer writes, unscoped consumer read
findings.suggestion: Same base-root anchoring; add a render test asserting observability-writing commands share one root contract.

reasoning.conclude: same defect, judged P1 rather than P0

findings.summary: Item 4 depends on undocumented Bash cwd persistence instead of explicit path resolution
findings.suggestion: Have round_record resolve base root explicitly like stage_agent_ledger does.
findings.evidence: stage_agent_ledger.py calls resolve_base_root(Path.cwd()); round_record does not

reasoning.observe: codex_ledger had this exact worktree-loss bug fixed once already per CLAUDE.md
reasoning.trace: round_record keys off raw cwd in all three callers
reasoning.conclude: explicit resolution is the documented remedy in this repo

findings.summary: PRIVACY.md claims the .hm-round scratch file 'is overwritten by the next round'; the filename is keyed by round, so each round writes a new file and nothing sweeps them
findings.suggestion: State the truth: overwritten only when the same (slug, round) is reused; otherwise one file accumulates per round with no janitor.
findings.evidence: PRIVACY.md:31-34 vs round_record.record_path building f'{slug}-r{round}.json'; no sweep found in worktree.py/readiness.py

reasoning.conclude: false retention claim in the document whose job is retention

findings.summary: Record-fields list still enumerates disposition_counts immediately above the instruction to leave it out; churn_* were correctly removed from the same list
findings.suggestion: Drop disposition_counts from the enumerated field list, matching the churn_* treatment.
findings.evidence: review.md.j2:1138-1139 lists it; :1141 says to omit it

findings.summary: `if opts.slug and opts.round_n:` treats --round 0 as absent, silently skipping the round-record write
findings.suggestion: Use `is not None` in review_consensus.py:679 and review_churn.py:598.

findings.summary: merge() read-modify-write holds no lock; two live producers on one (slug,round) silently lose an update
findings.suggestion: Take a short flock around the RMW, or narrow the docstring's 'harmless in practice' claim to the single-run case.

findings.summary: No test combines an ABSENT record with a model-supplied disposition_counts, so `if measured: ... else: use supplied` passes the whole suite

findings.summary: A containment ValueError is folded into the same {} return as a missing file, so an escape attempt is indistinguishable from 'producer has not run'
findings.suggestion: Log the containment failure to stderr distinctly before returning {}.
